Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

offhand adverb

also off the cuff, impromptu, extempore, say offhand, offhand remark, on the spur of the moment

classical

Cic. Arch. 18: magnum numerum optimōrum versuum dīcere ex tempore (Lewis & Short s.v. tempus)
Traupman 353

ex tempore

offhand, on the spur of the moment, without preparation

Other words

  • dē summō pectore dīcere — to say offhand, without much thought

    also used · classical · Gell. 17.13.7 (Lewis & Short s.v. pectus); Traupman 353

    Literally “from the top of the chest”: said from the surface, not from the depths.

Examples

  • dictum incūriōsum

    an offhand remarkTraupman 353
